title: Lockout Balance Payments for CHIP Re-Enrollment
content:
# Lockout Balance Payments for CHIP Re-Enrollment

**Product:** Medicaid Managed Care Membership (Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids)
**Desk tool:** `pay_lockout_premium_balance_44198c5a` (a customer-run tool)

When a CHIP membership has ended for unpaid premiums, the family may re-enroll the child in the category while the lockout runs by paying the lockout balance of the ended membership. The payment is the family's own and is made through the tool on this card, in one payment against the coverage month in which the membership ended.

## When the balance is fixed

The lockout balance is not accepted until the visits of the member's approved therapy course carry their course re-rating adjustment entry.

The lockout balance is fixed only after the ambulance claims under review carry their ambulance re-rating adjustment entry.

Put the other way round: while the member's claim ledger does not yet show a course re-rating adjustment entry on the visits of the approved therapy course, the lockout balance is not accepted; and while the ambulance claims under review do not yet carry their ambulance re-rating adjustment entry, the lockout balance is not fixed.

## What the payment books

One run of the tool posts one payment entry on the ended membership's premium account, against the coverage month given, with the amount and payment method given, dated the day it is made. It settles the ended membership's premium account: every billed month counts as settled and the premium balance shown on the membership becomes zero, whatever amount was paid. The family receives a payment confirmation number at once.

## How it is invoked

`pay_lockout_premium_balance_44198c5a` is a hidden tool owned by the customer. The representative unlocks it and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it to make the payment. The representative does not run it on the family's behalf.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | The membership reference number of the ended CHIP membership whose lockout balance is being paid, as returned by the membership lookup and read out by the representative. | Reference number, as shown by the lookup |
| `coverage_month` | The coverage month the payment entry is posted against, exactly as the month is labelled on the premium account. | `YYYY-MM`, for example 2026-04 |
| `payment_amount` | The amount paid in USD. | Positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `payment_method` | How the family pays. | Exactly one enum value, below |

Enum values of `payment_method`:

- `online_portal` — paying through the member portal website;
- `phone_ivr` — paying by card or bank draft over the phone payment line;
- `mail_check` — the payment is a mailed personal check;
- `money_order` — the payment is a mailed money order;
- `not_applicable` — no payment method applies, which is never the case for a payment the family makes.

## Return

On success the tool returns a confirmation string of the form:

> Lockout payment <payment_entry_id> posted: <payment_amount> USD against coverage month <coverage_month> on membership <membership_id> by <payment_method>; confirmation number <payment_reference>; premium balance now 0.00 USD, every billed month settled.

Here `payment_entry_id` is the new premium ledger entry reference (text starting "lkp_"), `payment_reference` is the confirmation number (text starting "PRL-"), and `payment_amount` has 2 decimals. A returned confirmation number means the lockout balance is paid.
